title: Container Bookings: gate-in, loading, departure and closure milestones
content:
## Policy clause
For the Container Bookings product line, gate-in, loading, departure and closure are recorded by the terminal and vessel systems and are never set by the desk. A container is loaded only when the verified gross mass has been received, as recorded on the booking. Departure of a booking rated under a service contract credits the contract's lifted volume under the service contract rules.

## Milestone path
equipment released → gated in (the laden containers are received at the load terminal) → loaded (the containers are loaded on board the allocated vessel) → departed (the carrying vessel departs the port of loading) → closed (the containers are discharged and the booking file is closed)

## Points of judgement
**A customer asks the desk to mark the containers as gated in.** The desk does not set gate-in, loading, departure or closure; those milestones come only from the terminal and vessel systems.

**The VGM has not been received. Can the container be loaded?** No. A container is loaded only when the verified gross mass has been received.

**Does every departure credit contract volume?** Only the departure of a booking rated under a service contract credits that contract's lifted volume; a spot booking has no contract to credit.
